identity.title: Theme and bound the Studio language selector popup

origin.summary: Wide and Compact language checks exposed a platform-light blank dropdown popup inside the graphite Studio UI.

state.current_summary: PL-0014 is complete: StudioLanguageSelector retains the shared semantic ComboBox style, Wide and Compact labels and popup states are legible and bounded, language persists, and inspection state remains unchanged.

claims.text: StudioLanguageSelector opens a platform-light blank-looking popup that does not match the supported dark visual system.

problem.impact: Operators cannot reliably see which language is available or selected, and the popup is a conspicuous theme leak in both authoring layouts.

criteria.text: The language popup uses semantic theme resources and visibly renders Korean and English with correct hover, selected, keyboard-focus, pressed, disabled, and open states in Wide and Compact.
Changing language still updates the current UI and persists without changing recipe, source, ROI, result, Preview, Publish, or Run state.

context.summary: StudioLanguageSelector owns the visible language ComboBox, responsive density, and popup item template.

evidence.observation: On DISPLAY2, the open StudioLanguageSelector popup was a white surface with no legible Korean or English item text while the surrounding Studio remained graphite themed; keyboard selection still changed the application language.

evidence.kind: focused style, bounds, disabled-state, and build verification
evidence.observation: Debug and Release builds completed with zero warnings and zero errors; Workbench docking passed 87/87 and proved the shared ComboBox base, Wide/Compact bounds, and semantic disabled brushes.

evidence.kind: current Release EXE and fixed R0 validation
evidence.observation: Actual Release EXE on dynamically selected leftmost DISPLAY2 rendered dark, legible Korean/English Wide and 한/EN Compact popup, selected, keyboard-focus, pointer-hover, and click/open states. English survived normal restart while recipe, source, ROI, result, Ready 8, Preview 0, and Published 0 stayed unchanged. Both refreshed fixed-package ValidateOnly modes passed without launching the application.

events.summary: Selected the existing language selector and global theme as the narrow ownership boundary; no new settings surface or language subsystem is being introduced.
Resolved PL-0014 after shared-style restoration, Compact density correction, focused regression, actual EXE Wide/Compact state verification, documentation closure, and fixed R0 validation passed.
